request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Recolour only the orange sail: it becomes dull desaturated mid-brown leather like an old saddle, colour #8a4a1c with #5a2e10 shadows, not orange; its stitched square patches stay pale hide. Keep everything else, the boat shape, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
